description: §7.3.3 — a block binds each name once. `let x` redeclaring parameter `x` (p1), a second `let y` in the same block (p2), and `function z` redeclaring `const z` in the same block (p3) are each E-SCOPE-REDECLARE — three occurrences — instead of reaching codegen and failing there as an unexplained E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC.
rationale: §7.3.3: inside a function body a let/const/lin/function declaration SHALL NOT redeclare a name already bound in the same block (another declaration, or a parameter in the function's top-level block).
